channel.title: Art Ninja
channel.desc: Ricky crafts mini masterpieces, is set challenges by viewers, creates dynamic DIY animations and then gets out and about on his trusty skateboard to make epic art with a ninja twist! Gav plays a deviously brilliant prank on Ricky, so he decides to get his own back using 6,000 cups of juice. All this with a helping of ninja art - a fake plaster cast, a 3D initial and some lovely prank soap.
